group_policy: Reuse frozen related-CVE group IDs; recompute crossing-period exclusions at the new anchor. No relaxation of links or duplicate rules.
eligibility: Observed Day-90 target and at least one observed score in each history. Export only the intersection for matched history comparisons.
text_policy: Reuse the source-aware adapter with Day 60 as anchor. Undated descriptions/summaries stay retrospective. Posts need consistent stored dates strictly before Day 60. No historical authentication is inferred.
planned_comparisons: Persistence at Day 60, identical under both matched histories
Recent EPSS Days 30-60 versus longer EPSS Days 0-60, same CVEs and 30-day forecast horizon
Future matched source-aware TPG+EPSS variants, only after source and graph previews
limitations: New preparation is not a continuation or replacement of R07; targets and cohort assignments differ.
Lower error at a later anchor would not establish an earlier warning or better prediction before the increase.
Date-level EPSS observations do not establish exact daily release times.
Group definitions remain conservative and can connect different CVEs through shared links.
Validation has informed prior development; this is not independent final evaluation.
Partial histories remain masked; Day-90 targets are never imputed.
No numerical test labels, histories or test text are exported or analyzed. Full-source integrity checks still verify the frozen files.
Graph caches and training runners for the new task are not built by this preview.
